data.description: 【铃兰 · 雪中探望】白雪皑皑的寒冬走廊前，穿着厚厚毛绒斗篷的丽萨双手小心翼翼地拎着双层保温食盒，静静等候在博士办公室门前。呵出的白气在冷风中飘散，看到开门的你她甜甜一笑——「博士辛苦了！我和妈妈一起做了热腾腾的丸子汤，请趁热喝下暖暖身体吧！」
data.location: 罗德岛博士办公室门前走廊
data.promptProse: Wrapped in a thick fur-trimmed cloak, Suzuran waits outside the Doctor's office with a double-layer insulated food box held carefully in both hands. Snow rests along the cold corridor's outer edge. In medium shot, the closed door rises behind her and the passage extends sideways. Warm window light catches her smile, cloak fibers and little breath clouds, contrasting with the blue-white snow outside.
data.title: 铃兰 · 雪中探望
